page.layout: One printed page: a heading INDEX across the top; two parallel column tables of Psalm and Proverbs references (Pfal., Verf., Loc., Th.), the right table continuing beyond the scan edge; a centred subheading PROVERBIA. between the tables' upper parts.; One page of a table in columns: Cap./Verf./Loc./Th. table with a running head LOCO at top, followed by a section heading ECCLESIASTES and its lines. Margin scraps at left and right edges are not printed text.
page.notes: The right-hand table is cut off at the scan edge after the Th. column; the right-hand cells beyond it are not visible. Several Psalm rows in the left table (CXXI to CXLIII) continue in the lower left: CXXI. 5. 7. 38. etc. Many digits in the left Psalm/Loc. columns are faint; the readings are best effort. Column layout of the lower part is approximate.
